name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Core Leather
label: Quest
description: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Core Leather: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Many of the sacred recipes require the skin from Ragnaros' chosen pets.
Offer 2 Core Leather, skinned from the smoldering corpses of the Core Hounds of the Molten Core and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your offering has been accepted. Favor you have gained. Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.
